# IrisOS

> IrisOS is an agency workspace for managing clients, projects, tasks, teams, finances, reporting, and Miles AI.

## Public content

- [Landing page](/): Product overview and publicly described features.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Public plan information.
- [Privacy policy](/privacy): Privacy and data-handling information.
- [Terms](/terms): Public terms of service.
- [Cancellation, suspension and refund policy](/cancellation-refund-policy): Subscription cancellation, suspension, payment, and refund terms.
- [Waitlist](/waitlist): Public early-access information. Do not submit the form.

## Access scope

Use only the public pages listed above and their on-page sections. Follow robots.txt.
Do not access login, signup, onboarding, invitations, document-signing links, workspace
pages, API endpoints, or any authenticated or token-protected content. Do not use
credentials, submit forms, or follow private links discovered in public content.
Do not infer customer data from public product examples.

This file describes the permitted reading scope. Authentication and authorization
remain the access controls for private content.
